en.name: Vizier
en.ability: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.
en.flavor: An excellent decision, as always, sire. Such a petty crime as bumping into the Bishop indeed deserves your ‘justice’ and ‘mercy’. Take a stroll in the gardens. Visit the gallery and peruse the sculptures of Von Strauf. Relax, sire. Leave everything… to me.
